'''Yan''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Farmer/Legends|Farmer]] who was native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prine]] and was the older brother of [[Maddie]]. One early morning, he was farming outside the gates of the small walled-off community with his sister when a group of [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] attacked. Unable to get within the protection of the town's walls, Yan was shot in the stomach and [[Death/Legends|killed]], while Maddie was captured and put in chains.
